title: Nigeria farm activity defaults (diesel, electricity, yield guides)
description: Screening-level diesel (L/ha/yr), grid electricity (kWh/ha/yr), and yield guides for Nigerian farms when the Equipment & Energy step has no measured fuel/electricity. Same structure and keys as the Ghana table (mechanization x irrigated). Values are Tier-1 activity defaults with wide uncertainty (factor 2), pedigree 'estimated'. Values carried over from the Ghana table are listed per row in provenance.inherited_from_ghana. Never invent fertiliser rates here.

provenance.span: 73% of Nigerian farm households use neither tractor nor animal traction (Takeshima H & Kennedy A (2019) Mechanization in Nigeria, FtF Innovation Lab for Food Security Policy, Research Brief 98, Table 1 (LSMS-ISA 2010-2016): 4% of farm households use tractors, 24% animal traction, 73% neither. https://cgspace.cgiar.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/c25df961-baf0-4886-9e94-e5ec03ad6e6b/content). Rainfed manual: 0 L diesel and 0 kWh.
provenance.yield_source: FAOSTAT QCL (Crops and livestock products), Nigeria, element Yield, 2023, bulk file Production_Crops_Livestock_E_Africa.zip (https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/Production_Crops_Livestock_E_Africa.zip), retrieved 2026-11-12. Flags: rice A (official); maize, sorghum, groundnut, millet, soybean X (external); cassava, yam, cowpea, tomato, cocoa, oil palm FFB E (FAO estimate). National averages, not split by irrigation or mechanisation; '_default' 1200 is the Ghana table's screening default (inherited, flagged).
